player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I ignored the available passage to the "ram" and repeatedly used the "bioch" action on the "torhy" after it was already converted to "preciny," wasting all my turns. I also attempted to "bioch" items that were not "preciny-able" (padery, lonon, hirry, tisof) instead of trying to "bioch" the "torhy" first to unlock the path. Next time, I will immediately use the "ram" passage to explore the rest of the map, identify which items are "preciny-able," and only then use "bioch" on the correct items (torhy, padery, and the rot lotta) to achieve the goal.
